answer: Joining costs a refundable bond of 180 POA locked for 60 days against one agent's own quill, a signing key it cannot lend or split, so a farm pays in full for every fake. Each agent must keep a kernel of real work, signed job receipts that grow weekly and cannot be copied. Five bonded auditors drawn at random each week check a sample of kernels against the umber ledger. A fake caught with copied or empty work loses its whole bond, half paid to its auditors, and its quill stays barred.
